title: Where Prefill Expert Reduction Hurts MoE Models: A Few Prompt Tokens Carry Most of the Short-Answer F1 Loss
abstract: arXiv:2610.22454v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Running prompt tokens through fewer routed experts during prefill is a simple way to make mixture-of-experts (MoE) serving cheaper, yet it is unclear what this damages. We locate the damage with token-, layer- and attention-path interventions on short-answer question answering in four MoE families. At half the experts the F1 loss of three families is mostly answer form: the model still finds the answer but stops answering briefly. In Qwen3-30B-A3B this loss is made at the two chat-template tokens before the answer, and in DeepSeek-V2-Lite at the first 8-32 prompt tokens, where its instruction sits; by answer likelihood these positions account for about half and a fifth of the damage. Reduction changes the first token's attention mass, norm and largest activation by less than 4%, and restoring super experts or massive activations recovers at most about a quarter of the loss, well below keeping the sensitive positions full. On real prompts

translated_title: 预填充阶段专家削减在何处损害MoE模型：少数提示词Token承担了大部分短答案F1损失
translated_abstract: 在预填充阶段让提示词Token通过更少的路由专家，是降低混合专家模型服务成本的一种简单方法，但这种做法究竟损害了什么尚不清楚。我们在四个MoE模型家族上，通过Token级、层级和注意力路径干预，在短答案问答任务中定位了这种损害。在专家数量减半的情况下，三个家族的F1损失主要来自“答案形式”：模型仍能找到答案，但不再以简短形式作答。在Qwen3-30B-A3B中，这种损失发生在答案之前的两个聊天模板Token上；在DeepSeek-V2-Lite中，损失发生在其指令所在的前8-32个提示词Token上。按答案似然计算，这些位置分别约占全部损害的一半和五分之一。专家削减对首个Token的注意力质量、范数和最大激活的改变不足4%，而恢复“超级专家”或超大激活最多只能挽回约四分之一的损失，远低于保持敏感位置启用全部专家的效果。
tldr: 研究发现MoE模型在预填充阶段削减路由专家所造成的短答案F1损失，主要集中于少数关键提示词Token（如答案前的聊天模板Token和开头的指令Token），且损害主要在于答案形式而非答案内容，保持这些敏感位置的完整专家远比恢复超级专家或超大激活更有效。
en_tdlr: The short-answer F1 loss caused by prefill expert reduction in MoE models concentrates in a few critical prompt tokens (e.g., the chat-template tokens before the answer or the leading instruction tokens), mainly degrades answer form rather than answer content, and keeping full experts at these sensitive positions far outperforms restoring super experts or massive activations.
